scripts.ios:run: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.ios:run:device: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios --target=device
scripts.ios:run:simulator: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios --target=simulator
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.android:run:device: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android --target=device
scripts.android:run:emulator: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android --target=emulator
scripts.native:build: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.native:open: npm run build && npx cap sync && npx cap open
